info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with the Android Device Performance Framework
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with the Android Device Performance Framework

returnvalues.name: available
returnvalues.doc: Return true if the PerformanceHintManager API is available on the device

parameters.name: available
parameters.doc: Return true if the Thermal API is available on the device

elements.name: adpf.thermal.get_headroom
elements.description: Provides an estimate of how much thermal headroom the device currently has before hitting severe throttling.

parameters.name: forecast_seconds
parameters.doc: how many seconds in the future to forecast

returnvalues.name: headroom
returnvalues.doc: a value greater than or equal to 0.0 where 1.0 indicates the SEVERE throttling threshold

elements.name: adpf.thermal.get_status
elements.description: Get the current thermal status of the device

returnvalues.name: status
returnvalues.doc: The current thermal status of the device. One of THERMAL_STATUS_XYZ.

elements.name: adpf.thermal.THERMAL_STATUS_CRITICAL
elements.brief: Platform has done everything to reduce power.
elements.description: Platform has done everything to reduce power.

elements.name: adpf.thermal.THERMAL_STATUS_EMERGENCY
elements.brief: Key components in platform are shutting down due to thermal condition.
elements.description: Key components in platform are shutting down due to thermal condition.

elements.name: adpf.thermal.THERMAL_STATUS_LIGHT
elements.brief: Light throttling where UX is not impacted.
elements.description: Light throttling where UX is not impacted.

elements.name: adpf.thermal.THERMAL_STATUS_MODERATE
elements.brief: Moderate throttling where UX is not largely impacted.
elements.description: Moderate throttling where UX is not largely impacted.

elements.name: adpf.thermal.THERMAL_STATUS_SEVERE
elements.brief: Severe throttling where UX is largely impacted.
elements.description: Severe throttling where UX is largely impacted.
